Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all distinct molecules referenced in document CHEMBL1131436. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by chembl_id CHEMBL1131436. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to ensure canonical SMILES are available. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort rows by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
